verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for a cloud SaaS converter with a web app, API and CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents any telemetry, analytics, or tracking opt-out control. The file-deletion policy (uploads deleted instantly, outputs after 24 hours) is an adjacent data-retention behavior, not a usage-tracking opt-out, so it earns no credit.
